chunks.description_en: The viewpoint moves forward through a shallow, water-filled stone canal under an arched bridge, with a blue 'PLAZA B' sign visible on the right wall. The weapon inspection of a Butterfly Knife with a red blade begins.
chunks.description_zh: 视角在拱桥下水深较浅且蓄水的石质水渠中向前移动，右侧墙壁上可见蓝色的“PLAZA B”标识。开始检视一把红刃蝴蝶刀。

chunks.description_en: The viewpoint enters a dark stone tunnel as the camera turns to the left, leaving the bright canal and the B sign behind. The Butterfly Knife inspection continues in the dark interior.
chunks.description_zh: 随着镜头向左转动，视角进入漆黑的石质隧道，将明亮的水渠和B区标识留在身后。漆黑的内部继续检视蝴蝶刀。
chunks.view_change: left turn showing the dark tunnel entrance

chunks.description_en: Moving through the dark stone tunnel, the camera sweeps slightly left to align with the bright exit ahead. The red blade of the Butterfly Knife continues to spin.
chunks.description_zh: 在漆黑的石质隧道中移动，镜头稍稍向左扫过，与前方明亮的出口对齐。蝴蝶刀的红刃继续旋转。
chunks.view_change: minor left turn aligning with the tunnel exit

chunks.description_en: The viewpoint continues straight forward through the stone tunnel towards the bright exit, where fallen tree trunks are visible. The weapon inspection is ongoing.
chunks.description_zh: 视角继续穿过石质隧道径直向前，朝着可见倒下树干的明亮出口移动。武器检视仍在进行中。

chunks.description_en: Emerging from the tunnel into a bright jungle clearing, the camera turns right and tilts up toward a stone slope. The Butterfly Knife inspection is completed.
chunks.description_zh: 从隧道中出来，进入明亮的丛林空地，镜头向右转动并向上倾斜，朝向一处石质斜坡。蝴蝶刀的检视完成。
chunks.view_change: right turn and look up showing the stone slope

subject_list.subject_attribute: The agent wears charcoal grey tactical gloves and holds a Butterfly Knife with a metallic red blade in a two-handed grip before initiating a weapon inspection.

environment_detail.area_or_callout: Water under the bridge leading towards B site (canal/tunnel)
environment_detail.opening_view: A first-person view in a shallow, flooded stone canal or trench under an arched stone bridge. The water surface is murky green-brown with reflections. To the right is a rough stone wall with a prominent blue wooden sign pointing to 'PLAZA B'. In the background, sunlit stone ruins and jungle trees are visible beyond the stone bridge structure.
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: A linear flooded canal or tunnel that runs under stone structures. The lane transitions from a sunlit open trench into a dark, enclosed stone archway tunnel before emerging into a bright, mossy jungle path with fallen trees blocking direct paths, requiring a right-hand turn up a stone slope.
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: Ancient stone blocks, weathered brick walls covered in moss and vines, a muddy/sandy bottom beneath shallow water, wet floor reflections inside the dark tunnel, and dirt and grass with ferns in the outdoor section.
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: A wooden sign with 'PLAZA B' and an arrow painted in blue/white on the right wall, overhead stone arches, and horizontal fallen tree trunks in the clearing outside the tunnel exit.
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: High contrast between bright outdoor sunlight in the canal/clearing and deep shadows inside the stone arch tunnel. Light shafts filter through the tunnel openings, creating reflections on the wet surfaces.
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: No HUD elements are visible, providing a clean gameplay view.
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: Shallow water ripples and wet surface reflections.

segments.visual_description_long: The view is positioned in a shallow, water-filled stone canal under a large arched bridge. The stone walls on either side are built of large weathered blocks, with the wall on the right featuring a blue painted wooden sign indicating the direction to 'PLAZA B'. Sunlit ancient structures and foliage are visible in the background through the open archway. The first-person viewpoint is moving straight forward along the canal, with the water surface showing ripples. Sunlight illuminates the canal from above, highlighting the texture of the mossy stone walls.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> moves forward in a shallow canal while holding a Butterfly Knife.</Action1>
<Action2><|Subject1|> begins to inspect the Butterfly Knife, flipping the red blade in the hand.</Action2>

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint continues forward and approaches the entrance of a dark, stone-walled tunnel. The large blue 'PLAZA B' sign on the right wall passes out of view as the perspective shifts. <Camera1>The camera pans smoothly to the left, scanning the entrance of the dark tunnel and revealing the thick stone pillars supporting the archway.</Camera1> The lighting shifts rapidly from bright daylight to deep shadow as the tunnel interior is entered. Wet ground reflections appear on the stone floor.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action3><|Subject1|> moves forward, transitioning to a forward-right strafe while holding the Butterfly Knife.</Action3>
<Action4><|Subject1|> continues to inspect the Butterfly Knife, twirling it in the right hand.</Action4>

segments.visual_description_long: Inside the dark stone tunnel, the perspective is centered on the bright exit ahead. The tunnel walls consist of rough, dark stones with mossy patches. <Camera2>The camera continues to sweep slightly to the left before stabilizing, framing the tunnel exit in the center of the screen.</Camera2> The exit reveals a bright, sunlit outdoor clearing with a fallen log. The contrast is high, with the dark tunnel interior framing the bright outdoor scenery.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action5><|Subject1|> strafes forward-right, then transitions to moving straight forward.</Action5>
<Action6><|Subject1|> continues the weapon inspection of the Butterfly Knife, spinning it in a clockwise motion.</Action6>

segments.visual_description_long: Moving steadily through the low-ceilinged stone tunnel towards the exit. The perspective remains focused on the opening, which grows larger in the frame. The details of the outdoor clearing, including green foliage, moss-covered ground, and fallen tree trunks, become clearer. The stone floor inside the tunnel is wet, reflecting the bright light from the exit. The side walls of the tunnel remain in deep shadow, guiding the eye towards the sunlit exterior.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action7><|Subject1|> moves forward toward the tunnel exit.</Action7>
<Action8><|Subject1|> continues the Butterfly Knife inspection, showing the red blade rotating.</Action8>

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint exits the stone tunnel, emerging into the bright, sunlit jungle clearing. The ground transitions from wet stone to mossy soil and grass. A thick, fallen tree trunk lies horizontally across the path in the middle distance. <Camera3>The camera pans to the right and tilts upward, scanning a stone ramp that leads up towards the right side of the clearing.</Camera3> Sunlit moss-covered ruins and lush green jungle vegetation frame the scene under a bright sky.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action9><|Subject1|> completes the weapon inspection of the Butterfly Knife, returning it to a standard grip.</Action9>
<Action10><|Subject1|> moves forward, emerging from the tunnel into the bright clearing.</Action10>

subject_list.display_name: 由玩家操控的 CS2 特工
subject_list.subject_attribute: 特工佩戴深灰色战术手套，双手握持一把带有金属红刃的蝴蝶刀，随后开始武器检视。

environment_detail.area_or_callout: 通往B区拱桥下的水渠（水渠/隧道）
environment_detail.opening_view: 第一人称视角，位于拱桥下水深较浅且蓄水的石质水渠或沟渠中。水面呈浑浊的绿褐色，伴有倒影。右侧是一堵粗糙的石墙，墙上有一块醒目的蓝色木质标识，指向“PLAZA B”。背景中，在石桥结构之外可见阳光照射的石质遗迹和丛林树木。
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: 一条在石质结构下方延伸的线性蓄水水渠或隧道。通道从阳光明媚的露天沟渠过渡到黑暗、封闭的石拱门隧道，然后通向一片明亮的、长满青苔的丛林小径，倒下的树木阻挡了直行通路，需要向右转弯走上石质斜坡。
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: 古老的石块、长满青苔和藤蔓的饱经风霜的砖墙、浅水下方的泥沙底、黑暗隧道内的湿滑地面反射，以及室外区域长着蕨类植物的泥土和草地。
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: 右侧墙壁上挂着一块蓝白相间、画有箭头和“PLAZA B”字样的木质标识，上方有石拱，隧道出口外的空地上有横放的倒塌树干。
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: 水渠/空地中明亮的室外阳光与石拱隧道内的深沉阴影之间形成强烈的对比。光线从隧道口滤入，在湿滑的表面上形成反射。
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: 没有可见的 HUD 元素，提供了干净的游戏画面。
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: 浅水涟漪和湿滑表面反射。

segments.visual_description_long: 视角位于一座大型拱桥下方水深较浅且蓄水的石质水渠中。两侧的石墙由风化的大石块筑成，右侧墙壁上挂着一块蓝色涂漆木质标识，指示通往“PLAZA B”的方向。透过敞开的拱门可以看到背景中阳光照射的古老结构和植被。第一人称视角沿水渠径直向前移动，水面泛起涟漪。阳光从上方照射进水渠，突显出长满青苔的石墙质感。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> 手持蝴蝶刀在浅水渠中向前移动。</Action1>
<Action2><|Subject1|> 开始检视蝴蝶刀，在手中翻转红色刀刃。</Action2>

segments.visual_description_long: 视角继续向前，接近漆黑的石墙隧道入口。随着透视关系的改变，右侧墙壁上醒目的蓝色“PLAZA B”标识移出视野。<Camera1>镜头平稳地向左转动，扫过黑暗隧道的入口，显露出支撑着拱门的厚实石柱。</Camera1> 随着进入隧道内部，光线迅速从明亮的日光转为深沉的阴影。石质地面上出现湿滑的地面反射。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action3><|Subject1|> 向前移动，手持蝴蝶刀过渡到向右前方侧移。</Action3>
<Action4><|Subject1|> 继续检视蝴蝶刀，在右手中旋转它。</Action4>

segments.visual_description_long: 在漆黑的石质隧道内部，视角聚焦于前方明亮的出口。隧道墙壁由粗糙且带青苔的暗色石块构成。<Camera2>镜头继续稍微向左扫过，然后稳定下来，将隧道出口框在屏幕中央。</Camera2> 出口展现出阳光明媚的室外空地以及一根倒下的圆木。对比度很高，黑暗的隧道内部将明亮的室外景致框入其中。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action5><|Subject1|> 向右前方侧移，然后过渡到径直向前移动。</Action5>
<Action6><|Subject1|> 继续检视蝴蝶刀，顺时针旋转它。</Action6>

segments.visual_description_long: 稳定地穿过低矮的石质隧道走向出口。视角保持聚焦于通道口，其在画面中逐渐变大。室外空地的细节（包括绿色的植被、长满青苔的地面和倒下的树干）变得更加清晰。隧道内的石质地面十分湿滑，反射着出口照入的强光。隧道侧壁仍处于深沉的阴影中，引导视线投向阳光照射的室外。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action7><|Subject1|> 朝着隧道出口向前移动。</Action7>
<Action8><|Subject1|> 继续检视蝴蝶刀，展示旋转的红刃。</Action8>

segments.visual_description_long: 视角走出石质隧道，来到明亮且洒满阳光的丛林空地。地面从湿滑的石块过渡到覆有青苔的泥土和草地。一根粗大且倒下的树干横卧在中景的通道上。<Camera3>镜头向右转动并向上倾斜，扫过延伸至空地右侧的石质斜坡。</Camera3> 阳光照射下长满青苔的遗迹和茂密的绿色丛林植被在明亮的天空下框出这幅景象。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action9><|Subject1|> 完成蝴蝶刀的武器检视，将其恢复至标准握持姿态。</Action9>
<Action10><|Subject1|> 向前移动，从隧道中走入明亮的空地。</Action10>
